label: BW-style / CLI-adapted

rubric_scores.evidence: Repeated beams, purlins and windows exist, but the roof is a plain slab. Representative columns combine centered intersecting boxes rather than two flanges and a web. The delivered hero does not explain structural joints clearly.
The broad zoning is retained: blue conveyors in front, upright tank between conveyors and raised machines, and vertical windows along the left wall. Relative equipment sizes are broadly plausible.

Several substantial housings occupy a deck with legs and edge beams. Their hero appearance is largely uniform pale gray, without readable brushed stainless highlights; the housing shader has no directional or surface-detail treatment.

Three stairs have matching yellow handrails, but uninterrupted front guardrails cross the stair arrivals, obstructing access to the deck. The uniform yellow shader also lacks the required restrained wear or surface variation.
Utilities comprise two bent ducts and two straight pipes with simple hanger rods. This is a sparse network without a readable reducer, fitted process connections or wrinkled foil cladding.
The upright tank has rounded heads, a top nozzle and flange, and four leg meshes in the correct zone. Its uniform bright mint-green appearance lacks the specified worn dark-green painted finish.

Substantial matte blue conveyor runs have supports, side rails and sparse transverse cylinders. The declared drive motor is only an undetailed box, without an identifiable motor, gearbox or drive connection in the supplied views.

The continuous green floor has strong reflections and the scene is bright and orderly. However, side-window daylight does not read clearly as the dominant key, and machine bodies and utilities lack the required differentiated brushed-metal and foil responses.

Principal equipment and roof framing are recognizable, with natural perspective. The hero is substantially more frontal than the requested diagonal view from a conveyor end, and its small, noisy presentation does not clearly explain the structure and utility layout.
The editable project opens, uses Cycles and AgX, and has no external texture dependencies. However, scene denoising is disabled at 16 samples and the original delivered image has conspicuous noise.
The original final.png is a valid, fully decoded PNG, but measures 512×267 instead of 3840×2160.

dimension_scores.evidence: The main industrial scene and color-coded equipment groups correspond, but machinery and utilities are greatly simplified.
Deck and conveyor supports are visible, but rails obstruct stair arrivals and utility terminations lack convincing installed connections.
Yellow guarding, green floor and tank, and blue conveyors remain distinguishable. Pale metallic surfaces and simplified silhouettes weaken the target appearance.
Box-like machines, faceted tank heads, sparse fittings and conspicuous delivered noise produce a preliminary model appearance.
Foreground, intermediate and raised rear zones remain coherent, although the installation is more sparse and regularly aligned than the target.
Tank, stairs, railings and machines share broadly plausible proportions. The very slender structural and platform members reduce industrial credibility.
Floor reflections and soft illumination establish a clean hall, but washed-out surfaces, weak daylight direction and absent foil detail limit material distinction.
All broad object classes are represented, but dense utility routing, structural connection details, recognizable drives and specified surface treatments remain incomplete.

same_model_bias_limit: Research and independent judge use Astra; separate sessions do not establish human independence.
